statement: A certificate's product name is caller context unless it is bound to immutable repository content. Deriving identity from a checkout directory makes two clones of the same commit differ for a reason unrelated to scores, findings, or evidence, so the identity fields must either come from a stable explicit input or be excluded from byte-comparison claims. Preserve zero-config compatibility, add one explicit input that controls both display name and slug, label the boundary on every human-facing certificate, and prove the repair by scanning two real differently named clones rather than comparing constructed report objects. Move condition: anchors when BargLabs/cejel #232 merges; verify the squash commit on origin/main adds --product-name, caller-context labels on terminal/HTML/Markdown, the two-real-clone byte comparison, and the artifact-byte changelog; batch into alfred maeve-lesson-batches with that commit, and confirm the cejel-site reproduction copy landed in the same release window.
